text.TIKTOK:
Why astronauts work out for hours every day
Without gravity, bone and muscle waste away. The treadmill, the bike and the weights are how they keep both.
Footage: NASA.
#astronaut #spacestation #nasa
text.INSTAGRAM:
Astronauts on the space station exercise for hours every day.

In microgravity the body stops carrying its own weight, and bone and muscle are lost. A treadmill with a harness, a bike and a resistance machine are how crews hold on to both until they are back on Earth.

Footage: NASA.
#spacestation #nasa #microgravity #astronaut
